development_banks.description: 128 states (two batches of 64 episodes, one query per episode at time 0, 25, 50 or 75), nine candidates each: the frozen actor's action (candidate 0), the zero command (candidate 1) and seven seeded uniform commands. V is the deterministic simulator continuation: the candidate once, then the same frozen actor to the horizon; discount 0.98; remaining horizon 100 - t; no terminal bootstrap. Q1, Q2 and U are the checkpoint's saved predictions at the same state and action.
development_banks.reference_definition: own-policy continuation of the 20k checkpoint's frozen actor, not Q-star, not a shared policy

matched_policy_pilot.interval_scope: Descriptive paired-episode percentile intervals conditional on each fixed final actor. Two continuation streams share one trained initialization; no independent-trained-seed or superiority inference.
limitations: Exploratory nominal-task pilot following development and reused calibration; no confirmation claim.
Two continuation streams share one trained initialization; episode intervals do not estimate independent-training variation.
No OOD environment shift, candidate reranking, evaluation-driven updates, intermediate selection, or automatic extension.
Zeus runtime remains outside upstream JAX/NumPy package constraints as previously disclosed.

original.scope: Descriptive action and induced state change relative to original actor, not an OOD validity or efficacy gate.
original.state_definition: All13 physical coordinates, steps1..100, divided by unchanged original training std[:13]+0.001; RMS across13 then equal time/episode mean. Remaining-time coordinate excluded. Original mean cancels in paired differences.

protocol.primary_return: float64 sum(t=0..99) gamma**t * reward_t; each final actor supplies every action; no candidate reranking
protocol.primary_screen: BCA mean paired return gain versus native AND distance must exceed the mean symmetric numerical band in EACH stream. Band per episode=1e-6+1e-6*max(abs(BCA_return),abs(control_return)). Exploratory numerical direction screen, not statistical superiority.
protocol.initialization_scope: Two replay/noise continuation streams from one trained checkpoint, not independent training initialization replications.
